subject.title: fix(ui): Realtime Talk hangs when Google Live connections stall

question: Should Google Live Realtime Talk impose this fixed 30-second deadline through Google `setupComplete`, accepting failure for successful connections that take longer than 30 seconds?
rationale: The code and proof support cleanup of an indefinite stall, but the exact deadline is a user-visible provider-availability policy rather than a mechanically determined correctness value.

options.title: Approve the 30-second deadline
options.body: Merge the bounded startup policy because a clear recoverable error and full media cleanup are preferable to indefinitely retaining browser resources.

options.title: Choose a different startup policy
options.body: Ask for a different deadline or retry/product behavior if Google Live’s expected setup latency makes 30 seconds too aggressive.

recommendation.title: Approve the 30-second deadline
recommendation.body: Merge the bounded startup policy because a clear recoverable error and full media cleanup are preferable to indefinitely retaining browser resources.
